caveats: Captured from the public Forge Steel website at version 14.198.0, which is NEWER than our pinned vendor source 14.197.0. Record the version difference; do not present the two as interchangeable.
It is a Polder Elementalist, not a Fury, so it evidences ancestry contributions rather than any class interaction.
It proves only what its retained artifacts actually show. It is not a witness for the three traits this unit newly enables.

removalExpectations.note: What must disappear when a parent choice changes. Stale selections are not active grants.
removalExpectations.dropNimblestep: Its readable entitlement disappears; no numeric field moves, because it contributed none.
removalExpectations.dropPolderGeist: Its conditionalEffects entry disappears entirely; ordinary speed is unchanged, because it never contributed there.
removalExpectations.dropReactiveTumble: Its readable triggered-action content disappears; no numeric field moves.
removalExpectations.changeAncestryAwayFromPolder: size returns to the 1M default, Shadowmeld and Small! are removed, every purchased Polder trait and its effects are removed, and the new ancestry's contributions apply. Class, career, culture, array and authored details are preserved.
removalExpectations.swapTraitWithinBudget: The removed trait's every effect disappears in the same evaluation that adds the new trait's; no residue of the old trait survives in derived values, readable content or provenance.

normalizedComparisonFields.forgeLimitations: If the pinned Forge build cannot represent a conditional speed bonus as a distinct field, record that as a recorded structural limitation with the closest comparison rather than an exact-match pass.
